List of mountains of Andaman and Nicobar

 
 

 Mountain
 Information
 
 

 Saddle Peak
 Saddle Peak is situated in North Andaman and it is the highest peak of Andaman and Nicobar measuring up to 738 meters. 
 
 

 Mount Divalo
 Mount Divalo is situated in Middle Andaman and it is the third highest peak of Andaman and Nicobar. 
 
 

 Mount Koyob
 Mount Koyob is situated in South Andaman and it is the fourth highest peak in Andaman and Nicobar.
 
 

 Mount Thuiller
 Mount Thuiller is situated in Great Nicobar and it is the second highest peak of Andaman and Nicobar.
